criteria.clothing: apparel, footwear, fashion accessories (belts, ties, bags)
criteria.computer_accessory: cables, adapters, docks, mice, keyboards, monitors
criteria.gift: items made to be given: flowers, gift baskets, greeting cards, branded merchandise
criteria.ground_transport: taxi, rideshare, transit, parking, tolls, fuel
criteria.health_otc: over-the-counter medication, cough and throat lozenges, first aid
criteria.household_goods: cleaning supplies, paper towels, kitchenware, drinkware, bedding, home décor
criteria.jewelry: non-electronic watches, bracelets, precious metal items
criteria.lodging: room charges, resort fees, lodging tax
criteria.other: anything that fits nothing above, including a non-itemized charge whose contents are unknown; explain it in the output
criteria.personal_care: toiletries, cosmetics, haircuts, spa and massage
criteria.personal_electronics: headphones, tablets, smart watches, cameras, trackers, and accessories made for them (cases, chargers)
criteria.service_fee: service charge, gratuity, delivery fee, booking fee

category.instructions: Choose the spend category of one line item from an expense receipt. The state gives the item text exactly as printed (it may be in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Japanese), the merchant name and the merchant category code (MCC). Classify what the item IS, not the words in its name: food cooked with alcohol (beer-battered fish, rum cake, wine sauce) is food_beverage; non-alcoholic drinks and mocktails are food_beverage; cooking wine is alcohol; barware and drinkware are household_goods. Accessories made for a personal device (cases, chargers) are personal_electronics; non-electronic watches are jewelry. Mobile phones, prescription medication and event tickets have no category of their own: choose other. A charge with unknown contents is other.
